source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 9 iulie — «Sfântul Cuvios Coprie Egipteanul»

attestations.note: The page the calendar links under this name carries the name and nothing else — no life, no troparion, no year. This is not the Copris the same site keeps on 24 septembrie, whom the corpus already holds: that one was born on the dung-heap beside the monastery of Theodosius the Cenobiarch in Palestine, and this line calls its man «Egipteanul». The two are separated here on the epithet and the day alone, and nothing else on this page bears on it.
